summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of CEO and Chairman John-Paul Backwell on April 21, 2026; he remains a director and senior strategic consultant. The board appointed Frederico Figueira de Chaves, formerly Interim CFO and CSO, as CEO effective the same date, and James Passin as Chairman on April 22. No financial terms, stakeholder stakes, or advisors are disclosed. This is a forced/abrupt leadership change triggered by the CEO's departure, constituting the event itself. Watch for strategic direction shifts, particularly the contemplated acquisition of Royal Uranium Inc. mentioned in forward-looking statements.
